```lean
theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (h₁ : x + y = 10) (h₂ : x - y = 4) : x * y = 21 := by
  have h3 : (x + y) + (x - y) = 14 := by
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    ring
  have h4 : 2 * x = 14 := by
    rw [h3]
    ring
  have h5 : x = 7 := by
    rw [h4]
    ring
  have h6 : y = 3 := by
    rw [h5, h₁]
    ring
  rw [h5, h6]
  ring
```
